name: Magnus Ulrich
source:
The not-so-venerable white king of Endgame. Forgetful, friendly, and prone to teasing, Magnus doesn't seem to command much respect from the organization he controls. And yet sometimes that joking tone is replaced with a coldness that startles even his closest companions. What is going through his mind when that silly smile turns harsh and calculating?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/steamberrystudio/gilded-shadows-a-gxb-sci-fi-adventure-otome-game]Kickstarter[/url]]
